release_notes:
fix: Full Screen menu icon + restyle Refresh API Orders page

- header.php: the Full Screen action used `fa fa-move`, which is not a real
  FontAwesome glyph, so the icon rendered blank on desktop. Use `fa fa-expand`.
- refreshapiorders.php: replace the bare title + green banner with a themed
  portlet (green box, caption, success alert) and report how many processing
  orders were actually re-armed per service type, plus an explanation and a
  Back To Dashboard button.
